facet: Purely local Node/Playwright rendering with zero cloud dependency: one Markdown source becomes slides, a script, long images, and PDF.
reel-kit: Built for unattended batch short-video generation: shot length is driven by the real narration audio, voiceover runs on local TTS at zero API cost, with five layouts and nine transitions built in.
claude-usage-statusline: Driven by Claude Code's native statusLine hook, a single-file Python tool with no dependencies that separates pay-as-you-go from subscription limits, so long-context sessions do not get cut off unexpectedly.
